admission.justification: The provider capability, agent-bound definition, provider-specific grant and retired assignment reader jointly bound what the role launch supplies to the host. FAM-N17BB4 accounts for this boundary with the other inputs of a valid create.

applicability: Role launches under the runtime provider capability branch.
conditions: The task-server definition is supplied only when accepts_tool_servers is true.

The exact Codex provider gets the ordered allowlist of the seat's role on the bound server, the same tools that server advertises. The exact Claude provider gets only server_info. Other provider IDs get no preapproval.
exclusions: The removed assignment_read grant and any alternative task reader.
An unconditional one-server or host-actual exclusion claim for a provider that declares supportsMcpServers=false.
Any claim that the first agent turn consumed the definition or that the grant governs ambient servers or shell commands.
statement: An ordinary role launch supplies its own bound AR task-server definition when the provider accepts MCP definitions. The launch policy grants Codex the ordered tool allowlist of the seat's role on that server and grants Claude server_info for the session. A provider that explicitly refuses tool servers receives no definition or harness-configuration fallback. The assignment_read tool and its former grant stay retired under D124.
